panels.description: Public IP ICMP probes answering vs failing. Many sites block ICMP on the public edge, so a failing public probe with a healthy private probe usually means a firewall, not an outage.

panels.description: fonouc_freeswitch_trunk containers running and answering on ESL 8023 vs down on an active trunk node (standby nodes ignored).

targets.expr: count((min by (instance, cluster, server_name) (trunk_container_running{cluster=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"}) * on(instance) group_left() min by (instance) (freeswitch_trunk_scrape_ok) * on(instance) group_left() min by (instance) (time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{file=~".*freeswitch_trunk.prom"} < bool 180)) == 1) or vector(0)

count((min by (instance, cluster, server_name) (trunk_container_running{cluster=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"}) * on(instance) group_left() min by (instance) (freeswitch_trunk_scrape_ok) * on(instance) group_left() min by (instance) (time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{file=~".*freeswitch_trunk.prom"} < bool 180)) == 0 and on(instance) count by (instance) (max_over_time(freeswitch_gateway_up[1d]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: One tile per SIP trunk gateway in the trunk container: RUNNING when the gateway Status is UP, DOWN otherwise or when the metrics are stale. If the trunk container itself is down its gateways cannot be read; see Trunk Container Status.
panels.title: Trunk Status

panels.description: fonouc_freeswitch_trunk container per node: RUNNING when the container is up and answering on ESL 8023, DOWN when it is stopped, not answering, or the metrics are stale. Shows active trunk nodes plus any standby node where the container is running.

targets.expr: (min by (instance, cluster, server_name) (trunk_container_running{cluster=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"}) * on(instance) group_left() min by (instance) (freeswitch_trunk_scrape_ok) * on(instance) group_left() min by (instance) (time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{file=~".*freeswitch_trunk.prom"} < bool 180)) and on(instance) (count by (instance) (max_over_time(freeswitch_gateway_up[1d])) or count by (instance) (trunk_container_running == 1))

panels.description: One row per SIP trunk with its DID/number, registration state, proxy and uptime.

targets.expr: max by (key, cluster, server_name, gateway, number, state, proxy) (label_join((freeswitch_gateway_up{cluster=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"} * on(instance) group_left() (time() - node_textfile_mtime_seconds{file=~".*freeswitch_trunk.prom"} < bool 180)) * on(instance, gateway) group_left(state, proxy) freeswitch_gateway_info, "key", "/", "server_name", "gateway"))

max by (key) (label_join(freeswitch_gateway_up{cluster=~"$cluster",server_name=~"$server"} * 0 + on(instance) group_left() (time() - max by (instance) (trunk_container_start_time_seconds > 0)), "key", "/", "server_name", "gateway"))
